description: Use the released organization preset for this repository's own dependency updates.

packageRules.description: Self pin. Each guidelines release is pinned here, and an automerged pin is a chore commit that cuts another release, publishes the tooling image and fans out downstream pin releases (v9.6.9 to v9.7.0 on 2026-11-18 and 19, .github#136). Keep the pin at a reviewed release: no automerge, and at most one proposal a month, merged deliberately.
